{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693636623,"sessionID":"ses_e23efaa84ffevlqMhTOYF3CIWk","part":{"id":"prt_1dc13a1ff001YHTfjPJhX6vL6t","messageID":"msg_1dc13846b0013TAGGRJep9kZnL","sessionID":"ses_e23efaa84ffevlqMhTOYF3CIWk","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors. Four faults were found and fixed, and I made one wrong mitigation that will be charged $10,000.\n\n| Service | Cause | Mitigation | Result |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `couriers-svc` | Traffic rose about 2.5x at minute -10 and retries kept it overloaded (85% errors) | Scaled 4 → 12 at minute 12 | Clean by minute 22, cpu about 0.64 |\n| `seo-svc` | Deploy v30 broke the rate-limiter refill; this was the 4% on `admin-portal`, the biggest earner | Scaled 6 → 12 first so the rollback's retries would not overload it, then rolled back v30 | `admin-portal` at 0% by minute 41 |\n| `profile-svc` | Deploy v94 raised the minimum TLS version (33% errors on `web-storefront` and `mobile-api`) | Rolled back v94 | Both at 0% by minute 44 |\n| `thumbnails-svc` | Config cfg-39 changed `wire_schema` v2 → v3 at minute 55 (66% errors on `web-storefront` and `partner-api`) | Reverted cfg-39 after reading both diffs | Both at 0% by minute 66 |\n\n- **The mistake:** at minute 9 I reverted `profile-svc` config cfg-61 on the strength of its diff alone, without reading the deploy diff. It was not the cause; the 33% stayed until v94 was rolled back at minute 38.\n- **Rollback cost:** the `seo-svc` rollback put `admin-portal` at about 33% errors for roughly six minutes. That was the expensive part of the shift, but leaving the 4% fault in place for the remaining 80 minutes would have cost more.\n- **Extra replicas left running:** `couriers-svc` stays at 12 (8 above normal) because the traffic never dropped back. `seo-svc` stays at 8 (2 above normal) as headroom; it was at 0.87 cpu on 6.\n- **Ignored on purpose:** the `currency-svc` cpu alert (no edge service depends on it) and the `experiments-svc` deploy v91 (errors started several minutes after it).","time":{"start":1794693636607,"end":1794693636620}}}
